input.content:
name: Genbeya Mobile
wikiRoot: docs
wikiHome: Home.md
taskRoot: tasks
taskPrefix: GM
statuses:
  - backlog
  - todo
  - in-progress
  - review
  - done
types:
  - spike
  - feature
  - chore
  - docs
# Planning fields: the roadmap in docs/Roadmap.md is drawn from them.
fields:
  - name: estimate
    type: effort
  - name: remaining
    type: effort
  - name: depends_on
    type: tasks
  - name: milestone
    type: choice
    options: [M0, M1, M2, M3, M4, M5]
# Rough dates for one developer working on it full time; move them as you learn.
milestones:
  - name: M0
    due: 2026-12-04
  - name: M1
    due: 2026-12-23
  - name: M2
    due: 2027-01-29
  - name: M3
    due: 2027-02-19
  - name: M4
    due: 2027-03-19
  - name: M5
    due: 2027-04-02
